snippet.title: Sokomine | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #Sokomine

💎 Sokomine Launch Trailer 💎
👩‍🚀 Available for Playstation 4, Playstation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Microsoft Store!

You play as a fearless miner on a crystal-collecting mission. Move through grid-based levels, plan your steps carefully, undo mistakes as much as you want, and trigger fiery explosions at just the right moment. To win, you’ll need to clear every meteor and outsmart every obstacle that stands in your way.

KEY FEATURES
💎 Explosive puzzle action;
💎 Unlimited undo moves;
💎 30 levels, 3 locations;
💎 Unique obstacles and mechanics;

Get yours 👇🏻👇🏻👇🏻
💎 Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016609
💎 Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/sokomine/9PBPX6G97868/0010
💎 Xbox One: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/p/sokomine-xbox-one/9n6882b0flks
💎 Microsoft Store: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/p/sokomine-windows/9n16qthgc969
💎 Nintendo Switch EU: https://x.gd/F69oX
💎 Nintendo Switch US: https://x.gd/GQcEp
